globalInvariants.environment: base allowlist plus exactly one explicitly selected credential group; Prime/OMP environment-key routes also receive one runner-owned private config-directory override; every Prime child receives the adapter-owned PRIME_AGENT_TELEMETRY=0 control
globalInvariants.terminal: harness terminal and exit code are necessary; language terminal-envelope recovery is separately required
globalInvariants.ordinaryExecution: explicit functional-alpha or strict-wrapper-conformant; never silently upgraded between tiers

environmentRules.nameMatching: case-sensitive on Unix and case-insensitive on Windows; USER is the POSIX account-name input required by installed harness login probes, while USERPROFILE remains the independent Windows profile-path input, and both are public non-credential values
environmentRules.credentialSelection: Pass only the names in the one credential group selected by an explicit auth-profile decision. If selection is ambiguous, fail before spawn.
environmentRules.credentialPresence: An explicitly selected token/key group must contain a non-empty credential before any harness launch. AWS Bedrock requires either AWS_PROFILE or both AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; region and session-token values are routing metadata and never credentials. Google requires GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS. Every Prime and OMP profile skips installed auth probes and retains unknown readiness; harness-login keeps the ordinary HOME-backed store, while environment-key routes receive a fresh runner-owned private config directory, never inherit ambient config-directory overrides, and never fall back to another credential route. Every OMP run strips ambient PI_CONFIG_FILES and uses a final wrapper-owned --config overlay that disables retry and the exact MCP-capable discovery-provider set without mutating user, global, or project configuration.
environmentRules.additionalNames: Only names explicitly configured by the user for this adapter invocation; values are never emitted.
environmentRules.adapterOwnedControlPolicy: Adapter-owned controls are exact non-credential child settings, never selected from ambient input. PRIME_AGENT_TELEMETRY=0 overwrites any ambient conflicting value for every actual Prime run; it is absent from OMP, Codex, and Claude run children and does not alter the selected credential group. Closed version inventory does not require this run-only control.
environmentRules.secretHandling: Secret values never enter argv, reports, diagnostics, observations, or benchmark artifacts. Tests compare names and redacted presence only.

image-utf8 is allowed only for a digest-verified non-secret image payload
NUL is rejected and platform argv byte limits are checked before spawn

rendered-config-path names a mode-0600 file in an owned private directory and never a user or project config file
rendered config bytes are mechanically produced from a closed harness template and the verified image; no language text is invented

daemon-socket-path expands to one fresh absolute path beneath an owned mode-0700 directory retained until the child and its exact owned service settle; allocation failure stops before spawn and never falls back to a harness default socket

a present Prime daemon socket must be a Unix socket in that exact directory and complete a bounded identity-checked protocol-v7 forced-shutdown exchange before private files are removed; cleanup failure preserves those files and overrides the run result
evidence stores source image, rendered config, and decoded model-visible image digests separately
argv and diagnostic evidence redact image content even though the canonical image is not a credential
the temporary file is removed only after the child no longer needs it
these delivery values are available only in the explicitly labeled functional-alpha tier until a recipe and both products pass strict adapter admission

The wrapper-owned mode-0600 overlay disables retry and the exact MCP-capable provider IDs native, omp-plugins, claude, agent-plugins, claude-plugins, codex, gemini, opencode, cursor, windsurf, vscode, and mcp-json; ambient PI_CONFIG_FILES is stripped, and the wrapper never writes user, global, or project configuration. A provider-free exact-18.0.9 startup probe observed three ambient Codex-imported MCP tools before the overlay and zero tools with the final overlay. disabledProviders is global rather than capability-scoped: cursor is the only listed ID that also intersects the standard model-provider descriptors, so Cursor-backed models are unavailable through this OMP adapter; no functional-alpha credential route uses that provider. The staged control remains available_commands_update then correlated get_state with empty dumpTools then prompt, so future provider drift fails closed. No model call was made.

The exact installed 18.0.9 session emitter adds boolean agent_end.isTerminal. False is a valid continuation boundary, not successful settlement, but multiple source paths continue through different retry, compaction, queued, maintenance, and async grammars, including paths with no causal start event. Functional alpha therefore fails closed as unsupported_nonterminal_settlement immediately on false and never records success. No model call was made.
